title: Omuziki gw’Ensozi mu budde obw’ekiro
intro: Wuliriza ng’ebiwonvu biwuuma n’okutendereza ku mabbali g’omuddu wa Allah omulonde. Eddoboozi eryaweebwa ekirabo ky’ennyimba, omusango abaakaayana gwe banoonyezebwa mu kisenge, n’ekyuma ekigonvuwa olw’ekiragiro kya Katonda birindirira okuzuulibwa. Kifaananyi ki eky’okusinza n’obufuzi obw’obwenkanya ekyogera okuyita mu bubonero buno?
clues: Allah yampa omukisa n’eddoboozi ery’okutendereza ery’omuziki.
Nasomesebwa Allah okutegeera olulimi lw’okusalawo okw’obwenkanya wakati w’abakaayana.
Nayolekagana n’omulwanyi omunene ow’amaanyi mu lutalo era olw’okwagala kwa Allah ne mbawangula.
Naweebwa amagezi, obuyinza n’ekyawandiikibwa ekyabikkulirwa ekya Zabbuli okuva ewa Allah.
Nagattako ensozi n’ebinyonyi mu kugulumiza Allah nange akawungeezi n’enjuba ng’evaayo.
Allah yanjigiriza okukola ekkooti za mail okuva mu kyuma ekyanfumbirwa ekigonvu.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
